intro: Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking and endpoints to mark an appointment as confirmed or undo confirmation. Prestique connects a custom AI agent to those endpoints so that when a caller asks about availability or confirms an appointment, the agent is working with live data from your system — not a separate copy.

You keep Zenoti. The agent works with it rather than replacing it. Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity and what the agent won't do. Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call.
